theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (F₀ : Set (Euclid (m + 1))) (v : Euclid (m + 1)), ‖v‖ = 1 → (∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → 0 < volume (F₀ ∩ ball (0 : Euclid (m + 1)) s) ∧ 0 < volume (ball (0 : Euclid (m + 1)) s \ F₀)) → (volume F₀ = 0 ∨ volume F₀ᶜ = 0 ∨ ∃ c : ℝ, volume (symmDiff F₀ {z | c < inner ℝ z v}) = 0) → volume (symmDiff F₀ {z | 0 < inner ℝ z v}) = 0
